audio.implementation: nxaudio-validated FMOD Ex to OpenSL ES to SDL bridge

framework.observability: nxobs is host-side sanitization only and is not linked or packaged

graphics.ownership: nxgl SDL/EGL share root with guest-owned child context and one engine swap

identity.nativeactivity_export_role: audited stock android_native_app_glue; adapter reproduces its observable setup and delegates directly to android_main

input.implementation: nxinput with one adapter-owned SDL_PollEvent loop
input.mapping: firmware SDL GameController mapping to Android key and motion events
input.terminal_combo: Select+Start and SIGTERM request the same focus-loss, save-state and pause path

dynamic_imports.fixed_guest_observed_requests: exact OpenSL ES surface plus __android_log_write through RTLD_DEFAULT
dynamic_imports.rc_implementation: generic host dlopen/dlsym compatibility fallback remains in the dynamic facade
dynamic_imports.post_rc_hardening: use an exact OpenSL magic handle, map __android_log_write explicitly and reject all other dynamic requests

paths: game-relative Android external storage under sdcard/

prohibitions: do not reorder or skip the guest lifecycle
do not package owner-supplied Android data
do not claim an untested physical device family
do not promote the tilemap UV correction to a global framework default
do not package raw logs or nxobs support bundles

quirks.default: enabled only after structural tilemap match
quirks.effect: inset each matching 16-by-16 tile UV endpoint by one quarter atlas texel and promote only the hueshift UV varying to mediump
quirks.physical_status: active on Mali-450 but tile grid persists; mitigation is not a proven fix
quirks.selector: Titan Souls tilemap VBO layout and exact 16/1024 UV span

release_boundary: private-test RC; exact final binary quick boot proven on ArkOS Mali-G31 and NextOS Mali-450, but full gameplay of the exact packaged ZIP/SHA and universal support are not proven

terminal.action: native focus-loss, save-state and pause, then bounded _exit without unsafe guest GL destructors
